name: chalktalk
description: Create tutorial videos by chatting with AI. Authors and edits ChalkTalk video projects over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Create tutorial videos by chatting with AI.
interface.longDescription: ChalkTalk turns a conversation into a narrated tutorial video. Describe a lesson, paste a pull request, or start from a template; ChalkTalk writes the project YAML, validates it, renders preview stills you can check, and generates narration. Projects open in the ChalkTalk editor for review and export.
